newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila suspends trading of Bogo Medellin.
newsitem.headline: Manila suspends trading of Bogo Medellin.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange said on Thursday it has suspended trading of Bogo Medellin Milling Co Inc upon the company's request.
The bourse said in an advisory to all traders it was asked by the sugar miller to suspend trading of its shares after its board approved the conversion of the firm into a holding company.

"In this regard, and to remove any undue speculations that may be experienced in the market as a result of this restructuring, the company has requested that the trading of its shares be suspended beginning July 24 until such time that the company has finished its restructuring," the exchange said.
Bogo Medellin shares were last traded at 40 pesos on August 14, 1996.
